parsed.why: Most Protective tier; strong statewide nondiscrimination, hate-crime coverage, gender-neutral bathrooms, shield law. National border and federal-facility exposure remains; no trans-specific violence documented.
Moderate-risk tier; no statewide gender-identity protections or hate-crime coverage, but no adult bathroom or care ban. Local ordinances cover under half the population; national exposure remains.
Worst-law tier; 2025 law bars gender-congruent facilities in schools and state buildings, with no statewide nondiscrimination or hate-crime coverage. Active tier-1 exposure and thin recourse.
Most Protective tier; comprehensive nondiscrimination, hate-crime coverage, shield law, care protection, self-attestation, gender-neutral restrooms. National border and federal exposure caps score.
Most restrictive: executive order defines sex for state facilities, shelters and custody; K-12 bathroom ban; public-care restrictions; closed documents; no nondiscrimination or hate-crime coverage.
